communication-patterns/claim-check.html.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant P as Producer
    participant S as Blob store
    participant B as Message broker
    participant C as Consumer
    P->>S: PUT large payload
    S-->>P: object URL / key
    P->>B: publish claim-check message
    B->>C: deliver reference
    C->>S: GET payload by reference
    C->>B: ACK after processing
communication-patterns/claim-check.html.caption: Claim check: store bulk data in object storage; the broker carries only a small reference token consumers redeem.

communication-patterns/command-pattern.h.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    api["API layer<br/>POST /orders"]
    factory["Command factory<br/>PlaceOrder DTO"]
    validate["Syntactic validation"]
    bus["Command bus / queue"]
    handler["Single handler<br/>Order service"]
    api --> factory --> validate
    validate -->|reject 400| api
    validate --> bus --> handler
communication-patterns/command-pattern.h.caption: Command flow: HTTP request becomes a typed command, passes validation, then one handler processes it asynchronously.

communication-patterns/competing-consume.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    q["Durable queue<br/>depth grows under load"]
    c1["Consumer 1<br/>prefetch, ACK"]
    c2["Consumer 2"]
    c3["Consumer 3"]
    c4["Consumer 4<br/>crash → visibility timeout"]
    dlq["Dead letter queue"]
    q --> c1 & c2 & c3 & c4
    c4 -.->|max receives| dlq
communication-patterns/competing-consume.caption: Competing consumers: multiple workers lease messages from one queue; failed processing returns work after visibility timeout.

communication-patterns/correlation-ids.h.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    client["Client"]
    gw["API gateway<br/>generates correlation ID"]
    a["Service A<br/>logs + propagates"]
    mq["Message queue"]
    b["Service B<br/>same header"]
    client --> gw --> a --> mq --> b
communication-patterns/correlation-ids.h.caption: Correlation ID propagation: generated at the edge and copied through logs, HTTP headers, and async message envelopes.

communication-patterns/event-notificatio.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    svc["Order service<br/>write DB"]
    topic["Topic: order-events"]
    inv["Inventory consumer<br/>fetch full order"]
    notify["Notification consumer"]
    audit["Audit consumer"]
    svc -->|skinny CloudEvents payload| topic
    topic --> inv & notify & audit
communication-patterns/event-notificatio.caption: Event notification: publishers emit minimal events; subscribers call back to the source for full state.

communication-patterns/event-streaming.h.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    prod["Producers<br/>keyed by order_id"]
    topic["Topic: orders<br/>partitions + replicas"]
    b1["Broker leaders"]
    g1["Consumer group: analytics"]
    g2["Consumer group: inventory"]
    g3["Consumer group: fraud"]
    prod --> topic --> b1
    topic --> g1 & g2 & g3
communication-patterns/event-streaming.h.caption: Event streaming: partitioned append-only log with independent consumer groups reading at their own offsets.

communication-patterns/fan-out-fan-in.ht.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    coord["Coordinator"]
    wA["Worker A"]
    wB["Worker B"]
    wC["Worker C"]
    wD["Worker D"]
    agg["Fan-in aggregator<br/>deadline + merge"]
    coord --> wA & wB & wC & wD
    wA & wB & wC & wD --> agg
communication-patterns/fan-out-fan-in.ht.caption: Fan-out / fan-in: coordinator dispatches parallel calls, then aggregates results within a deadline.

communication-patterns/inbox-pattern.htm.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    brk["Broker message"]
    cons["Consumer"]
    db[("Inbox table<br/>unique message_id")]
    biz["Business write<br/>same transaction"]
    brk --> cons
    cons --> db
    cons --> biz
    db -->|duplicate key| cons
communication-patterns/inbox-pattern.htm.caption: Inbox pattern: deduplicate at-least-once delivery by inserting message IDs in the same DB transaction as side effects.

communication-patterns/message-queues.ht.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    prod["Producer"]
    q["Durable queue"]
    c1["Consumer 1"]
    c2["Consumer 2"]
    c3["Consumer 3<br/>crash → redelivery"]
    dlq["DLQ"]
    prod --> q
    q --> c1 & c2 & c3
    q -.->|max receive count| dlq
communication-patterns/message-queues.ht.caption: Message queue: point-to-point delivery with competing consumers, visibility timeout, and a dead-letter path.

communication-patterns/message-routing.h.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    msg["Incoming message<br/>type, region, priority"]
    cbr["Content-based router"]
    eu["Queue: order-eu-high"]
    us["Queue: order-us"]
    dlq["DLQ"]
    slip["Routing slip<br/>step chain"]
    msg --> cbr
    cbr --> eu & us & dlq
    msg --> slip
communication-patterns/message-routing.h.caption: Message routing: content-based rules and routing slips steer messages to the correct downstream queues.

communication-patterns/pub-sub.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    pa["Publisher A"]
    pb["Publisher B"]
    topic["Topic: orders<br/>partitions 0–2"]
    sub1["Subscription: notifications"]
    sub2["Subscription: analytics"]
    sub3["Subscription: fraud"]
    pa & pb --> topic
    topic --> sub1 & sub2 & sub3
communication-patterns/pub-sub.html.caption: Pub/sub topology: publishers append to a partitioned topic; each subscription group receives its own copy of the stream.

communication-patterns/request-response..mermaid:
flowchart TB
    client["Client"]
    gw["API gateway<br/>auth, rate limits"]
    a["Service A<br/>cache"]
    b["Service B<br/>circuit breaker"]
    c["Service C<br/>circuit breaker"]
    client --> gw --> a
    a --> b
    a --> c
communication-patterns/request-response..caption: Synchronous request-response: client blocks through gateway and downstream calls with per-hop timeouts and circuit breakers.

communication-patterns/transactional-out.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    svc["Application service"]
    db[("Business DB + outbox table")]
    relay["Outbox relay<br/>poll or CDC"]
    broker["Message broker"]
    svc -->|single TX| db
    relay -->|read unpublished| db
    relay --> broker
communication-patterns/transactional-out.caption: Transactional outbox: domain write and outbox row commit atomically; a relay publishes to the broker.

communication-patterns/webhooks.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    prov["Provider<br/>event occurs"]
    disp["Webhook dispatcher<br/>HMAC signature"]
    ep["Consumer HTTPS endpoint"]
    q["Internal queue"]
    worker["Async worker"]
    prov --> disp -->|POST + X-Signature| ep
    ep --> q --> worker
communication-patterns/webhooks.html.caption: Webhooks: provider pushes signed HTTP callbacks; consumer acknowledges fast and processes asynchronously.

integration/anti-corruption-layer.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    domain["Your domain<br/>Order service"]
    acl["ACL<br/>facade + translator"]
    legacy["Legacy system<br/>SOAP / odd IDs"]
    domain --> acl --> legacy
integration/anti-corruption-layer.html.caption: Anti-corruption layer: translate legacy models at the boundary so domain code never imports foreign concepts.

integration/batch-integration.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    trig["Cron / file drop"]
    sched["Job scheduler<br/>Airflow, EventBridge"]
    ext["Extract"]
    trans["Transform"]
    load["Load"]
    trig --> sched --> ext --> trans --> load
integration/batch-integration.html.caption: Batch integration: scheduled jobs extract source data, transform in chunks, and load targets with checkpointed steps.

integration/canonical-data-model.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    a["System A<br/>SAP IDOC"]
    cdm["Canonical Order v2"]
    b["System B<br/>Salesforce"]
    a -->|A→CDM mapper| cdm -->|CDM→B mapper| b
integration/canonical-data-model.html.caption: Canonical data model: each system maps to one shared schema, reducing N² point-to-point transformations.

integration/change-data-capture.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    db[("Source DB<br/>WAL / binlog")]
    conn["CDC connector<br/>Debezium"]
    kafka["Kafka topics"]
    search["Search index"]
    dwh["Warehouse"]
    cache["Cache eviction"]
    db --> conn --> kafka
    kafka --> search & dwh & cache
integration/change-data-capture.html.caption: Change data capture: database transaction log becomes an event stream feeding search, analytics, and caches.

integration/data-synchronization.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    a["System A<br/>version + timestamp"]
    sync["Sync engine<br/>conflict rules"]
    b["System B"]
    a <-->|bidirectional| sync
    sync <-->|bidirectional| b
integration/data-synchronization.html.caption: Bidirectional sync: change detection and conflict resolution keep two systems convergent without dual writes.

integration/esb.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    sap["SAP"]
    sf["Salesforce"]
    mf["Mainframe"]
    esb["Enterprise service bus<br/>mediation, routing"]
    svc["Composite services"]
    sap & sf & mf --> esb --> svc
integration/esb.html.caption: ESB hub: adapters normalize heterogeneous endpoints; mediation and routing live in a central bus.

integration/etl-vs-elt.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph etl["ETL"]
        s1["Sources"] --> stg["Staging"] --> xform["Transform engine"] --> tgt1["Warehouse"]
    end
    subgraph elt["ELT"]
        s2["Sources"] --> raw["Cloud storage / warehouse"] --> sql["SQL / Spark in warehouse"]
    end
integration/etl-vs-elt.html.caption: ETL transforms before load; ELT lands raw data first and transforms inside the warehouse or lake compute.

integration/file-based-integration.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    partner["Trading partner"]
    drop["SFTP / S3 landing"]
    proc["Ingestion service<br/>validate, parse"]
    tgt["Downstream DB / ERP"]
    partner --> drop --> proc --> tgt
integration/file-based-integration.html.caption: File-based integration: partners drop batch files; polling services validate and load into operational systems.

integration/orchestration-vs-choreograph.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    orch["Orchestrator<br/>Temporal / Step Functions"]
    s1["Service A"]
    s2["Service B"]
    s3["Service C"]
    topic["Shared event topic"]
    orch --> s1 --> s2 --> s3
    s1 -.->|choreography| topic
    s2 -.-> topic
    s3 -.-> topic
integration/orchestration-vs-choreograph.caption: Orchestration centralizes workflow commands; choreography distributes steps via shared events each service consumes.

integration/streaming-integration.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    src["Sources<br/>CDC, apps"]
    kafka["Kafka"]
    flink["Stream processor<br/>Flink, Kafka Streams"]
    sinks["Operational sinks"]
    src --> kafka --> flink --> sinks
integration/streaming-integration.html.caption: Streaming integration: continuous events flow through a log into stream processors and real-time sinks.

data-architecture/data-cataloging.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    src["Data platforms<br/>DBs, lakes, BI"]
    crawl["Metadata harvesters"]
    cat["Data catalog<br/>search, lineage, owners"]
    users["Analysts / engineers"]
    src --> crawl --> cat --> users
data-architecture/data-cataloging.html.caption: Data catalog: automated metadata harvest plus business context makes datasets discoverable and governable.

data-architecture/data-contracts.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    prod["Data producer<br/>owns contract"]
    contract["Schema + SLA spec"]
    cons["Consumers<br/>pipelines, ML, BI"]
    prod --> contract --> cons
data-architecture/data-contracts.html.caption: Data contract: producer-published schema and freshness guarantees that downstream teams build against.

data-architecture/data-lake.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    src["Sources"]
    bronze["Bronze raw"]
    silver["Silver cleaned"]
    gold["Gold curated"]
    src --> bronze --> silver --> gold
data-architecture/data-lake.html.caption: Medallion data lake: bronze keeps raw files; silver validates; gold exposes business-ready datasets.

data-architecture/data-lakehouse.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    ing["Ingestion<br/>CDC, ELT"]
    obj["Object storage + table format<br/>Delta / Iceberg"]
    eng["Spark / Trino / SQL<br/>ACID + time travel"]
    ing --> obj --> eng
data-architecture/data-lakehouse.html.caption: Lakehouse: open table formats on object storage add warehouse semantics without abandoning cheap scale-out storage.

data-architecture/data-modeling-patterns.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    rel["Relational OLTP"]
    doc["Document"]
    graph["Graph"]
    ts["Time series"]
    vec["Vector"]
    rel & doc & graph & ts & vec
data-architecture/data-modeling-patterns.caption: Polyglot modeling: pick relational, document, graph, time-series, or vector shapes to match access patterns.

data-architecture/data-warehouse.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    src["Operational sources"]
    elt["ELT / Fivetran"]
    raw["Staging raw"]
    dim["Dimensional models"]
    bi["BI / semantic layer"]
    src --> elt --> raw --> dim --> bi
data-architecture/data-warehouse.html.caption: Cloud warehouse: ingest replicas land in staging, then dimensional models feed governed BI metrics.

data-architecture/database-indexing.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    q["Query pattern"]
    btree["B-tree index"]
    gin["GIN / GiST"]
    partial["Partial index"]
    q -->|equality, range, sort| btree
    q -->|JSON, full text, arrays| gin
    q -->|hot subset| partial
data-architecture/database-indexing.html.caption: Index selection: match PostgreSQL index families to equality, containment, and partial-filter access paths.

data-architecture/database-per-service.h.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    o["Order service<br/>Postgres"]
    i["Inventory service<br/>MongoDB"]
    c["Customer service<br/>Postgres"]
    o -.->|API only| c
data-architecture/database-per-service.h.caption: Database per service: each microservice owns its datastore; cross-service data flows through APIs, not shared tables.

data-architecture/event-store.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    cmd["Command handler"]
    es[("Event store<br/>append-only")]
    proj["Projections / read models"]
    cmd -->|append events| es
    es --> proj
data-architecture/event-store.html.caption: Event store: commands append domain events; projections rebuild current state and query models from the log.

data-architecture/graph-databases.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    u1["User Alice"]
    u2["User Bob"]
    p["Product"]
    u1 -->|FOLLOWS| u2
    u2 -->|PURCHASED| p
data-architecture/graph-databases.html.caption: Property graph: nodes and typed edges make multi-hop traversals like recommendations a native query pattern.

data-architecture/normalization-vs-denor.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    subgraph norm["Normalized OLTP"]
        cust["customers"] --> ord["orders"] --> items["order_items"]
    end
    subgraph denorm["Denormalized read"]
        flat["orders_denorm<br/>embedded customer + lines"]
    end
data-architecture/normalization-vs-denor.caption: Normalization removes update anomalies; denormalization duplicates data to cut joins on hot read paths.

data-architecture/oltp-vs-olap.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    oltp["OLTP<br/>row store, short txs"]
    etl["ELT / streaming"]
    olap["OLAP<br/>columnar scans"]
    oltp --> etl --> olap
data-architecture/oltp-vs-olap.html.caption: OLTP serves concurrent row updates; OLAP column stores power aggregation workloads fed by ELT or streaming.

data-architecture/polyglot-persistence.h.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    order["Orders<br/>PostgreSQL"]
    cat["Catalog<br/>MongoDB"]
    sess["Sessions<br/>Redis"]
    search["Search<br/>Elasticsearch"]
    order & cat & sess & search
data-architecture/polyglot-persistence.h.caption: Polyglot persistence: each bounded context uses the datastore that fits its consistency and shape needs.

data-architecture/time-series-databases..mermaid:
flowchart TB
    metrics["Metrics source"]
    tsdb["Time-series DB<br/>tags + fields + time"]
    roll["Rollups / downsampling"]
    dash["Dashboards / alerts"]
    metrics --> tsdb --> roll --> dash
data-architecture/time-series-databases..caption: Time-series model: tag-indexed series store high-cardinality metrics with retention and rollup policies.

data-architecture/vector-databases.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    docs["Documents"]
    chunk["Chunk + embed"]
    vdb["Vector index<br/>HNSW ANN"]
    query["Query embed + search"]
    llm["LLM / ranker"]
    docs --> chunk --> vdb
    query --> vdb --> llm
data-architecture/vector-databases.html.caption: Vector database: embedding pipeline indexes chunks; queries run ANN search to retrieve semantic neighbors for RAG.

search/autocomplete.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    ui["Client keystrokes"]
    api["Autocomplete API"]
    cache["Edge cache"]
    idx["Completion index"]
    ui --> api --> cache
    api --> idx
search/autocomplete.html.caption: Autocomplete: debounced prefix queries hit a completion index with caching for sub-50ms suggestions.

search/faceted-search.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    req["Query + facet filters"]
    svc["Search service<br/>bool query"]
    inv["Inverted index"]
    facets["Facet aggregations"]
    req --> svc --> inv
    svc --> facets
search/faceted-search.html.caption: Faceted search: keyword retrieval plus parallel aggregations return products and filter counts in one response.

search/full-text-search.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    src["Sources"]
    etl["Tokenizer + analyzer"]
    inv["Inverted index"]
    q["User query<br/>BM25 score"]
    src --> etl --> inv
    q --> inv
search/full-text-search.html.caption: Full-text search pipeline: analyzers build an inverted index; queries tokenize and rank hits with BM25.

search/geospatial-search.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    idx["Index with geo_point"]
    dist["geo_distance filter"]
    bbox["geo_bounding_box"]
    sort["geo_distance sort"]
    idx --> dist & bbox --> sort
search/geospatial-search.html.caption: Geospatial search: geo_point mappings enable proximity filters, bounding boxes, and distance sorting.

search/hybrid-search.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    q["User query"]
    bm25["BM25 retrieval"]
    ann["Vector kNN"]
    fuse["RRF or weighted fusion"]
    q --> bm25 & ann --> fuse
search/hybrid-search.html.caption: Hybrid search: parallel sparse and dense retrieval paths merge ranks so keywords and semantics both contribute.

search/search-infrastructure.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    master["Dedicated master nodes"]
    data["Data nodes<br/>shards + replicas"]
    coord["Coordinating nodes"]
    ilm["Index lifecycle<br/>hot → warm → cold"]
    master -.-> data
    coord --> data
    data --> ilm
search/search-infrastructure.html.caption: Search cluster: dedicated masters, data nodes holding shards, coordinators fronting queries, ILM rolling indices by age.

search/search-relevance-tuning.html.mermaid:
flowchart LR
    logs["Query logs"]
    judge["Human judgments"]
    tune["Feature / weight tuning"]
    eval["Offline NDCG eval"]
    prod["Production ranking"]
    logs --> judge --> tune --> eval --> prod
search/search-relevance-tuning.html.caption: Relevance tuning loop: labeled query–document pairs drive offline metric evaluation before promoting ranker changes.

search/semantic-search.html.mermaid:
flowchart TB
    docs["Documents"]
    emb["Bi-encoder embeddings"]
    idx["Vector / dense index"]
    q["Query embedding"]
    hits["Top-K similar chunks"]
    docs --> emb --> idx
    q --> idx --> hits
search/semantic-search.html.caption: Semantic search: dual encoders map queries and documents into vectors; ANN search retrieves meaning-aligned chunks.
